prompt: Miniature tilt-shift diorama, soft clay and felt toy-like 3D render, golden-hour light, shallow depth of field. An old brick canal lock with heavy wooden lock gates: the upstream water is high and calm, the downstream water is low. A small wooden sailboat waits inside the lock chamber while the gate begins to swing open. Beside the lock a plain wooden water-level gauge post with unmarked tick lines. Tiny trees and a towpath. Warm gold and sky-blue palette. Wide 2:1 composition. The left third of the canvas stays quiet and low-detail so a title can be placed there. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, people or robots.
